units.source_text: 竹叶间的光斑翩翩起舞时，逆光看去，真是蔚为奇观。

en.t: When the patches of light among the bamboo leaves fluttered and danced, seen against the light, it was truly a magnificent sight.

units.source_text: 柔和的阳光透过竹叶的景色，使人如痴如醉。

en.t: The scene of soft sunlight filtering through the bamboo leaves was enough to leave one entranced.
